events.title: DevLog#12 From an Empty Counter to a Living Shop Sim
events.summary: Devlog #12 : From an Empty Counter to a Living Cyberpunk Pawn ShopHey everyone,Looking back at where this journey started feels wild. I had this idea in the back of my mind for a long time, a vague vision, and back in May I finally gave it a shot. After getting a barebone prototype running, I had to share my thoughts with a devlog entry on Itch.io : just an empty room, a counter cobbled together out of cubes and capsules, and the bare-bones idea of running a dystopian pawn shop. events.title: Steam Deck Support
events.summary: Steam Deck SupportGhost Receipt is playable on Steam Deck using Proton and supports controller input.Most of the game can be played comfortably with a controller, but a few interactions may still require the touchscreen or mouse input.I am continuing to improve the Steam Deck experience as development progresses.

events.title: The Ghost Receipt Playtest Has Concluded earlier
events.summary: The Ghost Receipt Playtest Has ConcludedThe Steam Playtest for Ghost Receipt has now concluded.Thank you to everyone who took the time to play the current build.The playtest helped me identify remaining bugs, improve balancing and progression, and prepare the game for the next step.Development is now focused on final polish and getting the public demo ready.The Ghost Receipt demo will be available on Steam soon.Wishlist the game to stay updated.
